metadata.short_desc: Turn long replies into Telegraph links.
metadata.desc: Automatically publish AstrBot replies over a configurable length as Telegraph pages and send the links in chat.

enabled.hint: When disabled, the plugin does not process replies.

threshold_chars.hint: Publish plain-text replies longer than this value. The minimum is 50.

link_message.hint: Use {url} for the Telegraph links. All links are listed when content is split into multiple pages.

access_token.hint: Usually leave this empty. The plugin creates and persists an account automatically.
